diagnosis: The point-of-sale offline receipt endpoint queries transaction details using txnId via node:sqlite without verifying that the transaction's store_id corresponds to the store assigned to the logged-in cashier. Cashiers or compromised POS terminals at one store branch can retrieve transaction records, customer contact numbers, and payment details from other franchise stores.

GET /api/pos/transactions/txn_downtown_flagship_99182/receipt HTTP/1.1
Host: pos-gateway.retailgroup.local
Cookie: cashier_session=sess_suburban_branch_12
